installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p scripts supervisor .data
cp -R /opt/stoat-template/scripts/. scripts/
cp -R /opt/stoat-template/supervisor/. supervisor/
chmod +x scripts/*.sh
if [ -d source/.git ]; then
  git -C source fetch origin "${GIT_BRANCH}"
  git -C source checkout "${GIT_BRANCH}"
  git -C source merge --ff-only "origin/${GIT_BRANCH}"
else
  rm -rf source
  git clone --depth 1 --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" "${GIT_REPOSITORY}" source
fi
echo 'Instalação concluída. A compilação ocorrerá no primeiro início.'
